subject: Renewal: PO routing & split-invoice schedule for capacity increase
messages:
From: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@aureliahealth.com>
To: connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Cc: finance@aureliahealth.com
Date: Mon, 8 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PO routing for renewal + capacity uplift

Hi Connor,

Hope you’re well. Aurelia just approved the renewal and a 40% capacity uplift for Q3 — finance asked me to loop you in so we can get the PO routed and confirm invoicing cadence. Key items finance needs: a formal purchase order they can reference, the billing contact to receive invoices, bank wire and EFT instructions (or the option for prepay), and any company tax forms you need on file.

They lean toward a split invoice schedule (50% upfront, 50% at month 1 of the renewal) but will accept monthly invoices if Redwood prefers. Can you confirm: 1) preferred invoice schedule options, 2) the billing email and contact name to include on the PO, and 3) whether Redwood needs the W9 or any EU tax forms? I attached the preliminary PO template they use for larger vendors (Aurelia_PO_8472.pdf).

Thanks — Sofia Ramos
Procurement Lead, Aurelia Health
sofia.ramos@aureliahealth.com
(555) 312-0981

Attachment: Aurelia_PO_8472.pdf (application/pdf)
From: connor_obrien@redwood.ai
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@aureliahealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 8 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO routing for renewal + capacity uplift

Sofia — thanks for the heads up and congrats on the approval. Quick answers inline and next steps below.

1) Invoice schedule: We can support a split invoice (50/50) or monthly invoicing. For committed Dedicated-like capacity we usually recommend 50/50 for bookkeeping simplicity; monthly works if your AP prefers.

2) Billing contact: Please put invoices to billing@redwood.ai and copy billing-ops@redwood.ai. For the PO itself, the primary billing contact is Marissa Cole (Marissa Cole, Billing Manager).

3) Tax forms: We require a completed W9 for US entities. If Aurelia has an EU entity paying, we’d need the equivalent tax residency docs — but for this contract a W9 is sufficient.

Action items:
- Marissa will confirm invoice cadence and provide the invoice template and account info for wires/EFT.
- If Aurelia can return the signed PO (pdf) and a W9, we’ll issue the first invoice per the agreed schedule.

Marissa / Vivek — I’ve attached Aurelia’s PO. Marissa: can you confirm if we should request prepay vs net30 for this customer given the uplift and renew timing? Also confirm the banking details snippet we can share with their AP.

Thanks,
Connor O’Brien
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@aureliahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Jun 2026 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO routing for renewal + capacity uplift

Connor / Sofia — quick internal note and suggested wording for the PO.

- We can accept their attached PO, but ask that the PO include the Redwood remit-to name (Redwood Inference, Inc.) and our tax ID (EIN: 47-XXXXXXX). I’ll paste a one-line remit block you can add to their PO: 

  "Remit to: Redwood Inference, Inc. | EIN: 47-XXXXXXX | ACH: Redwood-Inference-ACH | wire: Redwood-WIRE-XXX"

- Terms: For a 40% capacity uplift on renewal, recommend Net30 standard. If Aurelia prefers the 50/50 split (one upfront invoice for 50%), we can accommodate and mark the second invoice as due in 30 days. Prepay is an option but not required.

- Attachments and evidence: Please ask for their signed PO (pdf) and a completed W9 (Aurelia_W9.pdf). If the payer is a separate subsidiary, we’ll need that subsidiary’s W9 or tax doc.

- Invoice cadence we will provide: Invoice 1 = 50% upon countersigned PO + 1st month usage; Invoice 2 = remaining 50% 30 days later. If monthly: monthly invoices on the 1st of each month with usage detail and token/commit breakout.

Connor, I uploaded a short invoice template and wiring snippet to our shared doc (link below). Once we have their signed PO + W9 I’ll kick finance to generate invoice 1.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Billing Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
